workouts.dayLabel: Friday - Lower B — Posterior Chain + Delts

Preserve this day's original duration, conversational effort; use 2.6 mph/10% only as a demonstrated reference, with no automatic increase or resistance load.

Adopt the demonstrated 80 lb working load: October 31 was 15/15 reps at RIR 2/1, up from 60/70 lb × 12 at RIR 4 on October 23. Aim for 12–14 reps at RIR 2–3 rather than forcing 15. No further load increase while the final set is below the effort target.

October 31 190 x15/15 at RIR 3/4 improved from October 23 170/190 x12 ending RIR 2; older machine records lack effort and may differ in setup. Ceiling with reserve supports the smallest available same-machine step at 12 reps/RIR 2. What setting follows 190? Keep demonstrated 190 x12 while confirming; replace the previous unverified 200 target, not an actual record.

Hold 70 lb and start at 10 reps. October 31 improved to 12/12/11 at RIR 3/2/1; October 23 included failed 80 lb sets at 8/7 reps and RIR 1. Build repeatable reps at RIR 2–3 before another heavier trial; do not force the last set to 12.

Hold 30 for 12–14 at RIR 2. November 2 two sets of 15 ended RIR 2, improving on October 26 RIR 1, but October 31 three sets of 15 ended RIR 1. This three-set day retains fewer reps to manage late fatigue. Older 40 x 10 succeeded on October 23; do not jump 33% without matching setup and repeatable effort. The two-set day can assess a smaller available step.

Nov 5 at confirmed 90 improved to 15/15/14 ending RIR 1 from Oct 31 15/14/12 ending RIR 0. Start with 12 reps and stop at RIR 2. Keep 90 while improving repeatability and use demonstrated 80 if the minimum 10 exceeds target effort.

Hold the successful 25 lb load and start at 10–12 reps at RIR 2–3. October 31: 25 × 10, 20 × 15, then 25 × 14, all RIR 2, improving on three 25 lb sets ending at RIR 0 on October 23. The heavier final set succeeded; do not default to the 20 lb middle set. Use 20 if fatigue prevents the minimum 10 at target effort.

Hold 30 lb for 12–13 reps at RIR 2–3. October 31 improved to 15/14 at RIR 3/1 from 30 × 10 followed by a failed 35 × 10 at RIR 0 on October 23. Reduce forced reps on the second set before another load increase.

Hold 70 lb and start at 12 reps at RIR 2–3. October 31 improved to 15/14 at RIR 2/1 from 12/11 at RIR 2/0 on October 23. Both sets now meet the minimum, so reassess fewer reps at 70 rather than automatically lowering the load; use a lower available setting if 12 cannot meet effort.

November 4 bodyweight 15/11/11 at RIR 2/1/3 with reported shoulder/grip fatigue, versus October 31 15/15 at RIR 2 and October 28 15/15/14 ending RIR 1. Start 10 controlled reps per set at RIR 2, stop if grip/shoulders limit form; final RIR 3 does not justify adding reps after the earlier fatigue. No external load. Exercise substitution needs a separate program decision; preserve the original exercise here.

Rep ceiling supports a conditional smallest available cable step, starting 10–12 at RIR 2. What step is available? Retain 70 x 15 until confirmed; no invented machine setting.
